# platform-ui commands

Every `platform-ui` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `platform-ui:catalog`

List the full UI catalog — primitives, components, and behaviors with their options and a11y.

```bash
bin/semitexa platform-ui:catalog
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--kind` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `platform-ui:css:build`

Precompile platform-ui CSS bundles for static asset serving via semitexa/ssr.

```bash
bin/semitexa platform-ui:css:build [bundle]
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--skin` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `platform-ui:css:explain`

Explain what a slice-id or primitive produces — CSS, layer, semantic token references.

```bash
bin/semitexa platform-ui:css:explain <id>
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `platform-ui:css:inspect`

Scan a template file for sx-*/ui-* usage and report what CSS slices/primitives it would need.

```bash
bin/semitexa platform-ui:css:inspect <path>
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--skin` | yes |
| `--json` | no |
